reference_sql:
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units) AS avg_unit_price_eur
FROM sales
WHERE parent_category = 'Accessories' AND channel = 'web' AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND units IS NOT NULL AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL
alternatives: SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) / SUM(units) AS avg_unit_price_eur FROM sales WHERE channel = 'web' AND parent_category = 'Accessories' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL AND units IS NOT NULL

SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) * 1.0 / SUM(units) AS avg_unit_price_eur FROM sales WHERE parent_category = 'Accessories' AND channel = 'web' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND NOT (units IS NULL OR net_revenue_eur IS NULL)
